description: Render a video from a movie JSON definition or a template with variables. Returns the video URL when done. When the status is done, call show_video with the url (and duration) so the user can watch it in the chat.

movie.description: Complete movie JSON as a string (will be parsed). Include scenes, elements, resolution, etc.

wait.description: Wait for render to complete (default: true)
